summary: A destructive button that only fires after a 1.2 second hold, filling a progress ring; releasing early cancels and drains the ring. Space and Enter work the same way.
use: Deleting data, sending money or any action that must be deliberate without a confirmation dialog.
spec: `const HOLD = 1200;` milliseconds to hold; progress is `(now - start) / HOLD` read in `requestAnimationFrame`
`stroke-dashoffset={C * (1 - (m.reduced && !done ? 0 : progress))}` on the ring circle, with `C = 2 * Math.PI * R`
`onkeydown` starts on Space or Enter (`!e.repeat`), `onkeyup` and `onblur` call `cancel`
`announce('Project deleted')` tells assistive tech when the hold completes; Undo resets
